name: runner-images
one_liner: The official virtual machine images GitHub Actions uses to run your CI and CD jobs — infrastructure plumbing, not a product.
buyer: No direct buyer — used internally by GitHub Actions; not something a business would separately purchase.
business_use_cases: A DevOps consulting firm references it to build custom, hardened CI runner images for clients with specific compliance needs.
A company self-hosting GitHub Actions runners uses it as the base image to replicate GitHub-hosted runner behavior.

money_ideas.idea: Paid consulting building custom hardened or self-hosted CI runner images for enterprise clients.

steal_this: No standalone weekend product here; it's a reference dependency, not something to build a business on directly.
